newsitem.title: USA: Pfizer halts commercialization of tenidap.
newsitem.headline: Pfizer halts commercialization of tenidap.

text.p: Pfizer Inc said Friday that it has decided to halt commercialization of Tenidap 120 mg. for rheumatoid arthritis.

The company said the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has issued a non-approval letter, which follows last May's FDA advisory committee recommendation against approving the drug for rheumatoid arthritis or osteoarthritis.
"The complexity and time required for further studies needed to address the scientific and regulatory issues surrounding the drug are simply too great," the company stated.
The company said it is helping patients who responded successfully to tenidap in clinical trials to make a "smooth transition to alternate therapeutic regimens."
Tenidap has been approved by six regulatory agencies outside the United States but is not yet commercially available in any country, the company said.
